draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Cuban Noobster (midlane→carry).

coaching.headline: Greystone finished 16/1 into a team where four of five were flagged for no armor — we won no fights, took no towers, and put 97 damage into objectives in twenty minutes.
coaching.team: The film is one hero eating the map: Greystone killed us sixteen times while four of the five of us carried no armor against a four-fifths-physical comp. The priced deaths tell it — the 9.2-9.7 falls bought Fangtooth at 10, the 14.7-14.9 falls Fangtooth at 16, and the 17-17.8 falls Mini Prime at 18 — while the carry and support were flagged ahead-or-absent at 2.8, 6.4, 11.8 and 13.2. Nobody was ever caught out alone; the losses were fights chosen and lost, which makes the fix simple: buy armor, decline the brawls, and play toward the late reads that actually favored us.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 14.1 fight — five of us against just Greystone and TwinBlast, lost 0-5 — is the game in one clip; the second Fangtooth followed at 16 and Mini Prime at 18.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Bayle drowned in the jungle — 1/9 with a single completed item at game's end. The jungle read actually turned favored late; the path there was farming camps and declining Greystone, not the four deaths to him between 5.1 and 17.5.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Wukong gave first blood at 2.8 and never got back up — 0/8, six of the deaths to Greystone, in a lane read 'theirs all game' with no armor bought against his 29k physical. That matchup is concede-and-hold: keep the tower, soak the wave, and let the winning carry and mid reads decide the game.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Fey won the mid read and proved it at the end with the 19.5-to-19.8 triple through Eden, Greystone and Kwang — but the mid-game falls at 9.2, 14.9, 17 and 17.8 are each priced by the file at a Fangtooth or Mini Prime. The Fey's fight is a clumped enemy walking into her zones; chasing Greystone through our own jungle is the opposite fight.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
ourKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

ourKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
ourKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
enemyKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,473 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Greystone offlane players this patch (43% of the team's). The damage came from Overlord, Cursed Scroll, Rapture.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Greystone dealt 29,454 hero damage, 43% of their team's, with +62 physical power from items.
Overlord (item): On Successful Basic Attack: Deal (+1%) Damage. Deal (+30%) (+2.5%) Damage around the Target. Damage decreases from 100% to 50% based on distance.
Cursed Scroll (item): On Basic Attack: Deal 20 (+3.5%) Damage to yourself and the Enemy Target. This damage cannot hurt you below 35% Health.
Rapture (item): While within 475u of an Enemy Unit: Your Basic Attacks deal 20 (+2.5%)(+15%) Damage On-Hit to them.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
Imperial Soul (augment): Stone Forged Soul deals 12% more damage and its radius is 20% larger.
Sustain: 11% omnivamp; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; 6,698 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1075 health, +40 physical armor, +30 magical armor; took 28,685 damage, mitigated 23,093, died 1 times.

(game text: Stone Forged Soul deals 12% more damage and its radius is 20% larger.) (changes Stone Forged Soul, 145s cooldown with their haste) Field: 52.6% in 1790 games, 17% of picks, level the hero-role's 51.9%.

Loadout crest Judgement: An area hit around you that heals you on hero hits. Use it with Make Way in the middle of a fight to top up. (game text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.) Field: 50.8% in 4223 games, 39% of picks, below the hero-role's 51.9%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Overlord, Cursed Scroll, Rapture.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Cursed Scroll, Aegis Of Agawar. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Rapture, Judgement.
Countered? 0 of the 5 players Greystone killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Aurora. We killed Greystone 1 time.
Copy it? Too few Greystone offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
